XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ACCESSORIES | SPEEDOMETERS | OFF | WARNING LIGHTS | DASHBOARD | INSTRUMENTS | INACTIVE | INDICATORS | ANALOGUE | RESET

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: all

  • System: accessories

  • Device: control unit body computer

  • Fault: the speedometer display remains off, no warning lights come on on the dashboard, the analogue instruments remain at zero, opening the driver's door causes the speedometer display to start working again

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: faulty body computer control unit

• Intervention: replacement of the body computer control unit

  • Procedure: after replacement, programming via self-diagnostic tester is not necessary

  • Notes:
    (1) replacement code 0051931819
    (2) intervention time approximately 1 hour
    (3) the control unit must be ordered based on the chassis number
